name: secret-scan-action
description: A free GitHub Action that scans PR diffs for leaked secrets (AWS/Stripe/GitHub/Google/Slack/OpenAI/Anthropic/npm/SendGrid/Twilio/Azure keys, DB connection-string passwords, private keys, JWTs, and generic high-entropy credentials) and fails the check on confirmed hits. Optional BYOK Claude triage cuts noise on ambiguous matches.
